label: Contract Renewal Risk Assessment
description: Assesses renewal risk for key accounts by analyzing usage trends, satisfaction signals, competitive threats, and relationship health. Produces risk-ranked renewal plan.

guidedInputs.label: Risk signals and account context
guidedInputs.placeholder:
Describe what you know about this renewal:
- Usage trends (increasing, flat, declining?)
- Satisfaction level and any recent feedback
- Relationship status with key contacts
- Any competitive threats you are aware of
- Budget or procurement signals
- Recent incidents or service quality issues
- Strategic changes in their organisation
- Any comments about the contract or pricing in recent interactions

guidedInputs.label: Previous renewal history
guidedInputs.placeholder: Was the last renewal straightforward or contentious? Were there price negotiations? What concessions were made?

guidedInputs.label: Expansion opportunity
guidedInputs.placeholder: Is there an opportunity to expand scope, add services, or increase contract value at this renewal?
